title: Braise
approval_scope: Explicit rename to Braise; full displayed RP, current/next damage and burn values, range, energy/cooldown and target/defense/delayed-burn/nonstacking conditions accepted as provisional balance. Only the heading name changes in the accepted card. Unshown curves, detailed hit/turn/stacking cases and native visuals remain pending.
accepted_conditions: One visible enemy with clear path; damage shown before target defenses.
Burn starts on next complete turn; same-agent applications of this burn do not stack.
unshown_rules_approval: Full rank curves, spell hit probability, projectile/actor collision and path geometry, damage/defense order and burn snapshot versus dynamic modifiers, exact tick/duration accounting, refresh/stronger-weaker reapplication, multiple authors, stacking with other fire effects, purge/resistance/critical/skill synergies and cost modifiers remain pending where not already accepted. No universal spell damage variance, active weapon damage multiplier, automatic hit, additional control, boss burn immunity or multi-target piercing introduced.
